about.description: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.
about.head: ab4fdc5

name: v2.2.4
body:
### Fixes
- fix(ci): OMP release step adds its dir to GITHUB_PATH (D-OMP-CI-6)
- fix(ci): OMP native install step stops after 6 min and hands off to the release step (D-OMP-CI-5)
- fix(ci): OMP binary from its GitHub release when OMP's install script gets no build (D-OMP-CI-4)
- fix: sandbox child env sets PYTHONUTF8=1 so python prints exact UTF-8 on Windows code pages (#1417)

### Who gets this

One version on both channels: the release commit on main (GitHub) and npm.

| Agent | Channel | Update with |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | GitHub | `claude plugin update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Codex | GitHub, npm for the one-time hook trust step | `codex plugin marketplace upgrade context-mode` |
| Gemini CLI | GitHub | `gemini extensions update context-mode` |
| Qwen Code | GitHub | `qwen extensions update context-mode` |
| Copilot CLI | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| VS Code (Copilot) | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| Kiro | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| ZCode | GitHub | `zcode plugins update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Pi | npm | `pi update --extensions` |
| OpenCode | npm | `opencode plugin update` |
| OMP | npm | `omp plugin upgrade context-mode` |
